description: Machine-readable scenario definitions for gRPC leadership benchmarking

environment.core_policy: pinned cores within host limits; single-core numbers never substitute for multicore scaling (contract 3.6)
environment.overload_policy: step offered load past saturation; retain all failures; report goodput, error rates and recovery (contract 3.7)

scenarios.name: Unary Empty Payload (Plaintext)
scenarios.description: Evaluates baseline HTTP/2 framing, HPACK header processing, and task scheduling overhead with 0-byte request and response.

scenarios.name: Unary Empty Payload High Concurrency (Plaintext)
scenarios.description: Saturated unary throughput test with 4 connections and 16 concurrent requests per connection.

scenarios.name: Unary 1 KiB Payload (Plaintext)
scenarios.description: Representative microservice unary RPC with 1024-byte request and response payloads over cleartext HTTP/2.

scenarios.name: Unary 1 KiB Payload (TLS 1.3)
scenarios.description: Representative microservice unary RPC over TLS 1.3 encryption (rustls vs reference peer TLS).

scenarios.name: Unary 64 KiB Payload (Plaintext)
scenarios.description: Medium-sized payload evaluating buffer slicing, chunking, and memory allocation across 64 KiB request and response.

scenarios.name: Server Streaming 1 KiB Download
scenarios.description: Server streaming RPC emitting 2,000 messages of 1024 bytes each, evaluating outbound frame batching and writer scheduling.

scenarios.name: Client Streaming 1 KiB Upload
scenarios.description: Client streaming RPC uploading 2,000 messages of 1024 bytes each, evaluating inline inbound decoding and window-update cost.

scenarios.name: Bidirectional Streaming Ping-Pong Empty
scenarios.description: Bidirectional full-duplex call with 256 empty request/response pairs exchanged in strict lockstep.

scenarios.name: Unary 1 MiB Large Payload (Plaintext)
scenarios.description: Large payload unary call testing flow control window saturation, zero-copy buffer transfer, and memory allocator behavior.

scenarios.name: Unary 1 MiB Large Payload (TLS 1.3)
scenarios.description: Large payload with TLS 1.3 encryption, assessing cryptographic throughput, memory churn, and TLS record framing.

scenarios.name: Unary 64 KiB Payload with Gzip Compression
scenarios.description: Medium-sized payload evaluated under gRPC gzip compression, testing compression framing, CPU trade-offs, and streaming deflater/inflater.

scenarios.name: Server Streaming 64 KiB Messages with Gzip
scenarios.description: Server streaming with 200 messages of 64 KiB each, compressed with gzip.

scenarios.name: Bidirectional Streaming Ping-Pong 1 KiB
scenarios.description: Bidirectional full-duplex call exchanging 256 messages of 1024 bytes in lockstep ping-pong.

scenarios.name: Bidirectional Streaming Pipelined 1 KiB
scenarios.description: Full-duplex streaming with interleaved simultaneous request and response streams at 1024 bytes.

scenarios.name: Client Streaming 64 KiB Upload
scenarios.description: Client streaming uploading 200 messages of 64 KiB each, testing window-update throughput.

scenarios.name: Unary 1 KiB High Concurrency Multiplexing
scenarios.description: Microservice unary RPC under high multiplexing: 4 connections with 64 concurrent requests per connection.

scenarios.name: Unary 1 KiB Overload and Recovery
scenarios.description: Offered load stepped past saturation to validate error accounting: all failures, timeouts and rejections retained in distributions; reports goodput, error rates and recovery time. Validation axis, not a leadership gate (contract 3.7).

scenarios.name: Unary 1 KiB with 10 ms Injected RTT
scenarios.description: Representative unary RPC over a real network with 10 ms injected round-trip delay, exercising window refill, pipelining and deadline paths hidden by loopback (contract 3.6).
